generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at 1; unique per table; never NULL; never overwritten by group/tie/duplicate stages.
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: Copy an existing parent primary-key value; never NULL unless the column is nullable; guarantee parent rows without children by skipping at least one parent value in the FK draw, never by nulling a child FK.
generic_sampling_rules.real_numeric: Uniform real values within the column's semantic range rule; include the range bounds themselves; do not generate values outside a declared BETWEEN range; allow ties at ORDER/LIMIT ranks.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Draw from a small pool of realistic short strings; allow near-duplicate variants and duplicates on DISTINCT columns.
generic_sampling_rules.text_date: Format 'Month D, YYYY' (e.g. 'August 18, 2007'); keep any table-level date order rule.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Draw only from the column's enum list.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For nullable columns, generate at least one NULL row per instance and a NULL share matching the compact database's share for that column; never replace a planted NULL; force at least one NULL when the materialized instance shows none. When the compact share is 0, the effective target is exactly one NULL per nullable column (share = 1/n).
generic_sampling_rules.composite_pk_aware_duplicates: When a table has a composite primary key, the duplicate stage on its key columns must preserve uniqueness of the full key tuple: after forcing duplicates on one key column, re-draw the other key column (or deduplicate on the tuple) so no (key1, key2) pair repeats; verify zero rows are skipped for that table and report the skipped-row count in the stats sidecar.
generic_sampling_rules.unmatched_parents_before_duplicates: Run the parent-unmatched stage before the duplicate stage on child FK columns, then re-validate both the duplicate share and the parent-unmatched invariant; re-plant duplicates if the share fell below its floor while keeping at least one parent unreferenced; exclude the chosen unreferenced parent value from any composite-PK repair pool; report the parent-unmatched invariant in the stats sidecar.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicate_share_floor: For a duplicate_share target of 20-50 %, set k = max(ceil(0.2 * n), round(share * n)) with share drawn from [0.2, 0.5], capped at n - 1, so the share never falls below the 20 % floor on small tables.
generic_sampling_rules.group_sizes_after_null: Run the NULL stage before the group-size stage, or re-verify the group-size distribution after the NULL stage and re-plant if the target is broken; the group-size stage must guarantee groups of size 1, 2 and >= 3 whenever the non-NULL count is at least 6, and must lower its guard (or re-plant after NULL) so the target is actually achieved for the specified table size; report the observed group-size distribution in a stats sidecar.
generic_sampling_rules.tie_rank_vacuous: A tie_at_rank r is vacuous when the table has fewer than r rows (LIMIT(r) returns all rows, so any tie at rank 1 also ties at the LIMIT boundary); record this in the spec and do not treat it as unsatisfied.
generic_sampling_rules.rows_with_different_values: For a scalar MAX/MIN target, verify that the non-NULL value distribution retains at least two distinct values (>= 2 per group with different values); the tie stage must not collapse the distribution so far that the target fails; report the distinct non-NULL count in the stats sidecar.
